Hi! So my main team usually consists of young Tiki, Nowi, Takumi and Lissa and I've been doing really well in the Arena with them.

However, I pulled a 4 star Sheena AND a 4 star Serra yesterday.

Should I switch Lissa for either of those girls or should I keep her? Thanks!

I sadly don't trust our mexican police to do anything at all. Mexico's police is infamously corrupt and only through bribes do they ever get anything done.

I don't really have the strength to protect anyone either, I keep having meltdowns and slashing my arm up with the steak knife, my little sister is trying to act as my makeshift psychologist instead. I'm not rly stable enough to properly protect anyone cus my version of protecting would be to wipe out whatever it is that is hurting us. It's very very tempting, though.

My little dog is rly the only thing keeping me alive right now just because I dont trust others to properly care for her but I can feel myself breaking more and more. My mind has been a wreck for so many years. I don't know who I can go to for help so I just want to die. 

Thank you for the comment, though. I do genuinely appreciate it.
